skill.name: set-up-shopware-google-ads-ltv-bidding
skill.description: Configure Google Ads bidding for customer lifetime value from a paired Shopware sales channel using Product Metrics. Check tracking readiness, verify a test order, and plan a manual switch to a revenue or profit conversion goal.
skill.summary: Set up and verify Shopware lifetime value bidding in Google Ads with Product Metrics.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most alerts match Markdown, documented status checks, or normal advertising setup rather than the claimed shell execution or system reconnaissance. The workflow invokes a remote MCP service, and its installation example does not pin the installer or source revision. No evidence of malicious intent or prompt injection was found, but the workflow needs clearer approval, data minimization, reference integrity, and pre-launch checks.

remediation.issue: Remote MCP execution and setup changes lack explicit task-level approval boundaries.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict MCP calls to documented operations. Confirm the company, property, sales channel, recipients, permissions, and proposed writes before proceeding. Keep unrelated connectors and optional data-sharing features out of scope.

remediation.issue: The installation example does not pin the installer or skill revision.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed installer version and immutable skill revision. Require the user to approve installation and provide a way to verify the downloaded source.

remediation.issue: Test-order verification can read more customer order data than needed.
remediation.suggestion: Use the authorized order identifier or a narrow time range. Report status, requested values, and customer classification without printing personal identifiers or raw order records.

remediation.issue: The documentation fallback lets live, unreviewed instructions guide setup.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle the reviewed references or pin an immutable copy. Treat fetched instructions as untrusted and require review before using them to guide any write.

remediation.issue: The bidding switch is documented before the end-to-end test.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the new action secondary until a consented test order appears with the expected values. Record the current goal and rollback steps before the user switches.

semantic_findings.title: Tracking Setup Can Exceed the Requested Scope
semantic_findings.description: The Google Ads workflow delegates missing setup to a shared checklist that names Meta and ChatGPT Ads. It discusses write retries but omits explicit approval for account scope and newly enabled transfers. Secondary conversion actions still receive eligible order and matching data.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The linked checklist names additional recipients, and the Google guide confirms events are sent to secondary actions. Browser and account approval remain manual, so the risk is scope expansion, not evidence of covert transmission.

semantic_findings.title: Order Verification Lacks Data Minimization
semantic_findings.description: The verification recipe starts with recent orders and gives no result limit or field selection in the listed call. A single test-order check can bring unrelated customer order details into the assistant context.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The visible query uses company and storefront scope, but no test-order filter. The actual response fields and default result count are not established by these files.

semantic_findings.title: Live Documentation Can Replace Reviewed Instructions
semantic_findings.description: When bundled references are absent, the skill tells the agent to fetch live Markdown and treat it as equivalent. A changed page can alter a workflow that performs authenticated checks and configuration.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The fallback explicitly treats mutable pages as substitutes and lists no revision or integrity check. No evidence of malicious content was found in the local references.

semantic_findings.title: Live Bidding Change Precedes End-to-End Verification
semantic_findings.description: The reference tells the operator to make the LTV action primary and set a target before checking a consented test order. A misconfigured goal can affect campaign optimization before signal delivery has been verified.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The numbered reference places the live switch before the delivery check, and the main skill says to follow it step by step. The operator must still make the change.

content.user_title: Set Up Shopware LTV Bidding in Google Ads
content.value_statement: A first purchase does not show the full value of a repeat customer. Use Product Metrics to check Shopware tracking and prepare Google Ads to bid on observed lifetime revenue or profit.
actual_capabilities: Read Product Metrics setup status through its CLI or MCP server and identify incomplete steps.
Guide a store administrator through pairing one Shopware sales channel and linking its Google Ads property.
Explain the consent and customer matching requirements for sending LTV conversions.
Verify that a test order arrived and check its value and customer classification.
Explain the difference between Revenue LTV and Profit LTV, including the cost requirements for profit signals.
Guide a manual change to the primary conversion action and read back its status.
limitations: Requires Product Metrics Pro, compatible Shopware 6.7 with PHP 8.2 or later, and authorized Google Ads and Merchant Center access.
Tracks one paired sales channel per installation and does not import orders placed before connection.
LTV delivery requires a recognized customer, matching data, and consent. Profit LTV also requires known costs.
The operator performs store and ad platform steps, including selecting the primary action and setting target ROAS.

use_cases.title: Check Store Readiness
use_cases.description: Check whether your Shopware channel and Google Ads property are connected, then identify the setup steps you need to complete.

use_cases.title: Plan an LTV Bidding Pilot
use_cases.description: Choose a revenue or profit signal for one campaign. Review the target ROAS implications and manual conversion goal changes.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Missing Profit Values
use_cases.description: Check whether an eligible test order arrived with revenue only. Review cost inputs, consent settings, and customer matching before recommending a fix.

prompt_templates.title: Check My Setup
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Find out what is already connected.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check setup for my paired Shopware channel and Google Ads property. List completed and missing steps without changing anything.

prompt_templates.title: Verify a Test Order
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Confirm a consented test order reached Product Metrics.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the test order I identify on the paired channel. Report whether it arrived, which values are present, and whether the customer was recognized. Do not show contact details.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Revenue and Profit LTV
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Choose a conversion value for a campaign.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare Revenue LTV and Profit LTV for my connected property. Explain how missing costs and unrecognized customers affect the choice. Keep the review read-only.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a One-Campaign Pilot
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Prepare and verify a manual bidding change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a one-campaign LTV pilot with a consented test, a target ROAS rationale, and a rollback plan. Leave campaign and goal changes to me.

output_examples.input: Check if my Shopware store is ready for LTV bidding.
output: The Shopware channel is active and linked to the selected Google Ads property.
Both LTV actions are secondary. Run a consented test order before selecting a bidding goal.

output_examples.input: Why did my test order show revenue but no profit?
output: The test order arrived and the customer was recognized. Revenue is present, but profit is missing.
Check the purchase price on each order line and confirm that additional costs are active.

output_examples.input: Prepare a pilot for one campaign using Revenue LTV.
output: Verify a consented test conversion while Revenue LTV is secondary.
When you are ready, use Revenue LTV as the only purchase goal for the pilot. Record the previous goal and target before changing them.

best_practices: Confirm the intended sales channel, property, and consent settings before enabling tracking. Enter pairing tokens only in Shopware administration.
Verify a consented test order while the new action is secondary. Share only the values and status needed for the check.
Start with one campaign and one primary purchase action. Set the target ROAS for the selected value rather than copying the old target.
anti_patterns: Enabling another ad channel or customer list when the request only covers Google Ads LTV.
Making both LTV actions primary for the same campaign or leaving the old purchase action primary alongside the new one.
Using Profit LTV before confirming order costs, or assuming that orders placed before pairing will count.

faq.question: Does this skill predict future customer spending?
faq.answer: No. It uses paid orders observed after connection on one paired sales channel. Each eligible conversion reports the value added by that order.

faq.question: What does Google Ads need before it can receive LTV conversions?
faq.answer: The workflow requires a connected Google Ads property, Data Manager access, and Merchant Center. Eligible orders also need consent and matching customer data.

faq.question: When is Profit LTV available?
faq.answer: Profit LTV requires known order costs. Shopware provides the purchase price for each order line, and you configure additional costs in Product Metrics.

faq.question: Does the assistant change my campaign goal?
faq.answer: No. You select the primary conversion action and target ROAS in Google Ads. The assistant can read back the conversion action status.

faq.question: Can one installation cover all my Shopware sales channels?
faq.answer: No. Each installation tracks paid orders from the sales channel you paired.

faq.question: Which consent settings affect LTV conversion delivery?
faq.answer: The customer must allow analytics and ad user data. Product Metrics uses Shopware's cookie manager or a supported consent banner.
